en.text:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Markov Chain' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks are removed on stow.

Melee Kills instantly <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine. Melee kills while Monte Carlo is being held grant all 5 stacks of Markov Chain.

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• <pve PvE: 13%|26%|39%|52%|65% />
• <pvp PvP: 6.6%|13.2%|19.8%|26.4%|33% />
